<!-- Generated by python-tui-lib/scripts/bundle-tiered-todo.sh — DO NOT EDIT. Source: ~/.claude/commands/verify.md -->

Scan `TODO.md` for items awaiting verification and run their verification steps.

An item is awaiting verification when its status is `verify`, with or without a tier:
`- [verify T3] …`, `- [verify] …`. The tier records which model *implemented* it; running
the steps is mechanical either way, so verify inline unless a step is genuinely expensive.

If `$ARGUMENTS` is non-empty, verify only items whose title matches it.

For each item:

1. Find the linked plan file from the TODO item.
2. Open the plan and locate the verification/testing section.
3. Run each numbered verification step **exactly as written**. Do not reorganize, rename,
   merge, or summarize the steps — the steps are the spec, the output is the evidence.
4. Show the exact command run (as a `$ command` line) followed by raw output in a code
   block below each step.
5. Add a **PASS/FAIL** note after each step. Report what actually happened — never claim a
   pass you did not observe.
6. **WRITE THE OUTPUT BACK INTO THE PLAN FILE** — update the verification section with the
   raw output and PASS/FAIL under each step. The plan is the permanent record.
7. **If every step passes**, promote the item to Done the same way `/todo done:` does:
   remove it from `## Open` entirely and insert a one-line entry at the top of `## Done` —
   `- [x] YYYY-MM-DD — [slug] what was verified. See [plan](path).` Drop the tier, and
   strip any `<!-- agent:… -->` stamp. **Never** rewrite it to `[x]` in place: `## Done` is
   the only place `[x]` belongs, and the PostToolUse hook blocks the write if you leave one
   in `## Open`.
8. **If any step fails**, leave the marker exactly as it is (`[verify T<n>]`, stamp intact)
   and report the failure with its raw output. A partially-passing item stays open.

If no items are awaiting verification, report "No items to verify."
